title: Stand-up Meetings
sub: What to say in daily stand-ups and quick team updates.

cards.def:
a short daily team meeting held standing up
हिंदी: स्टैंड-अप / रोज़ की छोटी टीम मीटिंग
examples: Our stand-up starts at ten sharp.
I'll share it in tomorrow's stand-up.
Can we keep the stand-up under fifteen minutes?
I missed the stand-up, so I posted my update in the channel.

cards.def:
a brief daily meeting in agile teams
हिंदी: डेली स्क्रम
examples: The daily scrum takes fifteen minutes.
We cover blockers in the daily scrum.
The scrum master runs the daily scrum on video.
Let's raise the release question after the daily scrum.

cards.def:
a standard opening to report past work
हिंदी: कल मैंने ... पर काम किया
examples: Yesterday I worked on the login page.
Yesterday I worked on fixing two bugs.
Yesterday I worked on the export feature and got it mostly done.
Yesterday I worked on the review comments from Priya.

cards.def:
a standard phrase to state today's work
हिंदी: आज मैं ... करने की योजना बना रहा हूँ
examples: Today I'm planning to write unit tests.
Today I'm planning to review two pull requests.
Today I'm planning to finish the dashboard filters.
Today I'm planning to pair with Ravi on the flaky test.

cards.def:
a phrase describing ongoing work
हिंदी: मैं अभी ... पर काम कर रहा हूँ
examples: I'm currently working on the payment module.
I'm currently working on the API changes.
I'm currently working on the performance issue in search.
I'm currently working on the docs for the new endpoint.

cards.def:
I finished something
हिंदी: मैंने ... पूरा कर लिया
examples: I wrapped up the report yesterday.
I wrapped up the migration script.
I wrapped up the code review before lunch.
Once I've wrapped up this ticket, I'll help with testing.

cards.def:
I started taking on a task
हिंदी: मैंने ... उठा लिया / शुरू किया
examples: I picked up a ticket from the backlog.
I picked up the search task.
I picked up the bug that Neha reported.
Yesterday I picked up the onboarding story.

cards.def:
I am about to start a task
हिंदी: मैं ... शुरू करने जा रहा हूँ
examples: I'm picking up the profile page next.
I'm picking up a new story today.
After this, I'm picking up the email notifications task.
Is anyone picking up the logging ticket, or shall I?

cards.def:
something that prevents progress
हिंदी: रुकावट / अटकाने वाली चीज़
examples: I have a blocker on the database access.
No blockers from my side.
The missing API key is a blocker for the integration.
Let me know if any blocker comes up during the day.

cards.def:
I cannot proceed until something is resolved
हिंदी: मैं ... पर अटका हुआ हूँ
examples: I'm blocked on the design approval.
I'm blocked on the test environment.
I'm blocked on access to the production logs.
We're blocked on the legal review for the new terms.

cards.def:
nothing is stopping my work
हिंदी: कोई रुकावट नहीं
examples: No blockers, all good.
I have no blockers today.
No blockers right now, but I'll shout if that changes.
Everything's moving; no blockers on the release.

cards.def:
something my work relies on
हिंदी: निर्भरता
examples: We have a dependency on the backend team.
The task has a hidden dependency.
The mobile release has a dependency on the new API.
Let's list every dependency before we commit to a date.

cards.def:
not able to continue until someone delivers
हिंदी: ... का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ
examples: I'm waiting on a review from Sam.
We're waiting on the vendor's reply.
We're still waiting on the final designs.
I'm waiting on QA to sign off on the fix.

cards.def:
need help
हिंदी: मदद चाहिए
examples: I need a hand with this deployment.
Could someone give me a hand?
Do you need a hand with the release notes?
I'll need a hand moving the old data later.

cards.def:
would benefit from assistance
हिंदी: थोड़ी मदद मिल जाए तो अच्छा
examples: I could use some help with the tests.
I could use some help debugging this.
I could use some help understanding the billing code.
If you're free later, I could use some help with the setup.

cards.def:
let's discuss this after the meeting
हिंदी: इसे मीटिंग के बाद अलग से देख लें
examples: Can we take this offline?
Let's take it offline after stand-up.
This is getting detailed; can we take it offline?
Good question — can we take it offline and include Sam?

cards.def:
set aside for later
हिंदी: इसे बाद के लिए रख दें
examples: Let's park that for now.
We'll park this discussion until Friday.
Let's park the naming debate and focus on the bug.
I'll note it so we don't forget the item we parked.

cards.def:
return to a topic later
हिंदी: बाद में इस पर लौटेंगे
examples: We'll circle back on this tomorrow.
Let me circle back after checking.
I'll circle back once I have the numbers.
Can we circle back to the budget at the end?

cards.def:
an early warning or notice
हिंदी: पहले से सूचना
examples: Just a heads-up, the server will restart.
Quick heads-up: I'll be out on Friday.
Thanks for the heads-up about the outage.
I'll give the support team a heads-up before we deploy.

cards.def:
for your information
हिंदी: आपकी जानकारी के लिए
examples: FYI, the release is delayed.
FYI, the doc is updated.
FYI, I've moved the meeting to three.
Just FYI, the client approved the new design.

cards.def:
a brief status message
हिंदी: संक्षिप्त अपडेट
examples: Here's a quick update on the bug.
Quick update from my side.
I'll post a quick update after the call.
Quick update: the fix is deployed and working.

cards.def:
a report on current progress
हिंदी: स्थिति की जानकारी
examples: I'll send a status update by evening.
Here is my status update.
Please include risks in your status update.
The status update goes to the client every Monday.

cards.def:
progressing as planned
हिंदी: योजना के अनुसार चल रहा
examples: The project is on track.
We're on track to release Friday.
Are we still on track for the demo?
Testing is on track, but the docs are a bit behind.

cards.def:
later than planned
हिंदी: समय से पीछे
examples: The module is behind schedule.
We're two days behind schedule.
We fell behind schedule because of the outage.
If we're behind schedule, let's tell the client early.

cards.def:
earlier than planned
हिंदी: समय से आगे
examples: We're ahead of schedule on testing.
The task finished ahead of schedule.
We finished the backend ahead of schedule.
Being ahead of schedule gives us time for extra testing.

cards.def:
likely to miss the plan
हिंदी: जोखिम में
examples: The deadline is at risk.
This feature is at risk.
Without more testers, the launch date is at risk.
I've marked the integration as at risk in the tracker.

cards.def:
falling behind schedule
हिंदी: पिछड़ रहा
examples: The release date is slipping.
The sprint goal is slipping.
If the design keeps slipping, we'll miss the launch.
Our timeline is slipping because of unclear requirements.

cards.def:
estimated time of arrival or completion
हिंदी: अनुमानित समय
examples: What's the ETA for the fix?
My ETA is tomorrow noon.
Do we have an ETA from the vendor?
I'll update the ticket with a new ETA.

cards.def:
before the working day finishes
हिंदी: आज दिन के अंत तक
examples: I'll finish this by end of day.
Please send it by end of day.
Can you confirm by end of day?
The draft will be in your inbox by end of day.

cards.def:
short form of by end of day
हिंदी: आज शाम तक
examples: I'll push the code by EOD.
Can you reply by EOD?
Please share the slides by EOD Thursday.
I won't make it by EOD; is tomorrow morning okay?

cards.def:
as the earliest task next day
हिंदी: कल सबसे पहले
examples: I'll fix it first thing tomorrow.
I'll review it first thing tomorrow.
I'll call the client first thing tomorrow.
Let's deploy first thing tomorrow when traffic is low.

cards.def:
currently being worked on
हिंदी: प्रगति पर
examples: The task is in progress.
Two tickets are in progress.
The design review is still in progress.
Please don't merge changes that are in progress.

cards.def:
completely finished
हिंदी: पूरी तरह निपट गया
examples: The migration is done and dusted.
That bug is done and dusted.
Once the tests pass, this feature is done and dusted.
The audit was done and dusted before the deadline.

cards.def:
finished and waiting to be checked
हिंदी: समीक्षा के लिए तैयार
examples: The pull request is ready for review.
My code is ready for review.
I'll mark the ticket ready for review.
Two pull requests are ready for review if anyone's free.

cards.def:
a request to merge code changes
हिंदी: पुल रिक्वेस्ट / कोड मर्ज का अनुरोध
examples: I raised a pull request this morning.
Please look at my pull request.
Can you add a description to your pull request?
The pull request needs one more approval.

cards.def:
checking a teammate's code
हिंदी: कोड समीक्षा
examples: The code review found two issues.
I have a code review pending.
I'll do the code review after lunch.
Thanks for the thorough code review.

cards.def:
to combine code changes into one branch
हिंदी: मर्ज करना
examples: I'll merge the branch after approval.
The PR was merged yesterday.
Don't merge until the tests pass.
Let's merge the feature branch on Monday.

cards.def:
to upload code changes to a repository
हिंदी: कोड पुश करना
examples: I'll push the fix shortly.
He pushed the changes last night.
Did you push your latest changes?
I pushed a small fix for the typo.

cards.def:
to release software to an environment
हिंदी: डिप्लॉय करना
examples: We'll deploy to staging today.
The team deployed the update.
We deploy to production every Tuesday.
Can you deploy the fix to staging so I can test it?

cards.def:
to revert to a previous version
हिंदी: पिछले संस्करण पर लौटाना
examples: We had to roll back the release.
Let's roll back and investigate.
If errors go up, roll back immediately.
We rolled back within five minutes, so few users noticed.

cards.def:
an urgent quick bug fix released immediately
हिंदी: तुरंत जारी होने वाला सुधार
examples: We shipped a hotfix last night.
A hotfix is needed for production.
The hotfix went live an hour ago.
Let's not add features to the hotfix; keep it small.

cards.def:
a defect in software
हिंदी: बग / सॉफ़्टवेयर की ख़ामी
examples: I found a bug in the checkout flow.
The bug is now fixed.
Can you log a bug with the steps you followed?
This bug only happens on older phones.

cards.def:
to make a bug happen again on purpose
हिंदी: बग दोबारा पैदा करना
examples: I couldn't reproduce the issue.
Can you reproduce it on staging?
Could you send me the steps to reproduce it?
I reproduced the bug on my machine.

cards.def:
the underlying reason for a problem
हिंदी: मूल कारण
examples: We found the root cause of the crash.
The root cause was a memory leak.
Let's fix the root cause, not just the symptom.
We're still looking for the root cause.

cards.def:
a temporary way of avoiding a problem
हिंदी: अस्थायी उपाय / जुगाड़
examples: There is a workaround for now.
I applied a workaround.
Until the fix ships, users can use this workaround.
The workaround is to clear the cache and log in again.

cards.def:
a fast but possibly temporary solution
हिंदी: त्वरित सुधार
examples: It's just a quick fix.
A quick fix solved the crash.
A quick fix is fine for now, but let's log the real fix.
I don't want another quick fix; let's do it properly.

cards.def:
a bug in something that previously worked
हिंदी: पुरानी चीज़ में नई गड़बड़ी
examples: The update caused a regression.
We caught a regression in testing.
Let's add a test so this regression doesn't come back.
Was this regression introduced in the last release?

cards.def:
a tracked task or issue in a system
हिंदी: टिकट / कार्य-पर्ची
examples: I'm closing the ticket today.
There's a ticket for that bug.
Please raise a ticket for that request.
I've linked the ticket in the pull request.

cards.def:
a feature request written from a user's view
हिंदी: स्टोरी / फ़ीचर का विवरण
examples: This story is in the current sprint.
I finished two stories.
Let's split this story into two smaller ones.
Who's picking up the search story?

cards.def:
a list of pending work
हिंदी: बैकलॉग / लंबित कार्यों की सूची
examples: Add it to the backlog.
The backlog is growing.
We'll review the backlog on Thursday.
This idea goes to the bottom of the backlog for now.

cards.def:
a fixed work period in agile development
हिंदी: स्प्रिंट
examples: We are halfway through the sprint.
The sprint ends on Friday.
This task won't fit into the current sprint.
At the start of each sprint we agree on the scope.

cards.def:
the main aim of a sprint
हिंदी: स्प्रिंट का लक्ष्य
examples: Our sprint goal is a working checkout.
We're on course for the sprint goal.
Does this ticket help the sprint goal?
We met the sprint goal despite the outage.

cards.def:
the amount of work a team completes per sprint
हिंदी: टीम की गति / वेलोसिटी
examples: The team's velocity has improved.
Velocity dropped this sprint.
We use velocity to plan the next sprint.
Don't compare velocity between different teams.

cards.def:
uncontrolled growth in project requirements
हिंदी: काम का दायरा बढ़ते जाना
examples: Scope creep delayed the launch.
We must avoid scope creep.
Let's put new requests in phase two to avoid scope creep.
The project suffered from constant scope creep.

cards.def:
units used to estimate effort
हिंदी: स्टोरी पॉइंट्स / प्रयास का अनुमान
examples: We estimated five story points.
This task is eight story points.
How many story points should we give this?
We completed thirty story points last sprint.

cards.def:
to decide what is most important
हिंदी: प्राथमिकता तय करना
examples: We need to prioritise the bugs.
Let's prioritise the login fix.
With limited time, we have to prioritise.
I'll prioritise the client's request this week.

cards.def:
the most important item
हिंदी: सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता
examples: This is our top priority.
Security is a top priority.
Fixing the outage is our top priority today.
Let's agree on the top priority for this sprint.

cards.def:
a problem that is now resolved
हिंदी: रुकावट दूर हो गई
examples: The blocker is removed, I can continue.
Good news, the blocker is removed.
Blocker removed — the access was granted this morning.
Once the blocker is removed, the work should move fast.

cards.def:
to remove an obstacle for someone
हिंदी: रुकावट हटाना
examples: Can you unblock me on the API?
I'll unblock you today.
Thanks for unblocking me so quickly.
What do you need from me to unblock you?

cards.def:
to meet to align on information
हिंदी: आपस में तालमेल बैठाना
examples: Let's sync up after lunch.
We sync up every morning.
Let's sync up before the client call.
We should sync up with the design team on Friday.

cards.def:
to make brief contact to share updates
हिंदी: संपर्क में रहना / हाल-चाल लेना
examples: Let's touch base tomorrow.
I'll touch base with the client.
Let's touch base next week about the hiring plan.
I just wanted to touch base on the project status.

cards.def:
to include someone in a conversation
हिंदी: किसी को शामिल करना
examples: I'll loop in the design team.
Please loop me in on that thread.
Can you loop in someone from security?
Thanks for looping me in.

cards.def:
to send a quick message
हिंदी: हल्का संदेश भेजना
examples: I'll ping you when it's done.
Ping me if you need anything.
Ping me on chat if it's urgent.
I pinged Ravi, but he hasn't replied yet.

cards.def:
to contact someone for help
हिंदी: संपर्क करना
examples: I'll reach out to the vendor.
Feel free to reach out.
Reach out to the platform team about the outage.
Thanks for reaching out about the bug.

cards.def:
to be responsible for something
हिंदी: ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
examples: I'll take ownership of this bug.
Who will take ownership?
She took ownership of the release process.
Please take ownership of the follow-up actions.

cards.def:
to be fully responsible
हिंदी: उसकी पूरी ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
examples: I'll own the release.
Someone needs to own it.
You found the issue, so you should own it.
We need one person to own the migration plan.

cards.def:
a task assigned in a meeting
हिंदी: कार्य-बिंदु / मीटिंग में दिया गया काम
examples: I have two action items.
The action items are in the notes.
Each action item needs an owner and a date.
I'll send the action items after the meeting.

cards.def:
the actions to be done next
हिंदी: अगले क़दम
examples: Let's agree on the next steps.
The next steps are clear.
What are the next steps from our side?
I'll email the next steps to everyone.

cards.def:
to finish or conclude
हिंदी: समाप्त करना
examples: Let's wrap up the stand-up.
I'll wrap up the work today.
We have five minutes left, so let's wrap up.
Before we wrap up, any other questions?

cards.def:
to limit a task to a fixed time
हिंदी: समय-सीमा तय करना
examples: Let's timebox this to one hour.
We timeboxed the discussion.
We timeboxed the spike to two days.
If we timebox the discussion, we'll finish on time.

cards.def:
having too much work
हिंदी: काम से लदा हुआ
examples: I'm a bit overloaded this week.
The team is overloaded.
If you're overloaded, let's move some tickets.
The support team is overloaded after the launch.

cards.def:
not available at work
हिंदी: दफ़्तर से बाहर
examples: I'm out of office on Friday.
She is out of office until Monday.
My out of office says who to contact.
I'll set an out of office reply before I leave.

cards.def:
absent from work with permission
हिंदी: छुट्टी पर
examples: He is on leave next week.
I'll be on leave tomorrow.
Who covers his tasks while he's on leave?
She's on leave, so the review will wait until Monday.

cards.def:
doing the job remotely at home
हिंदी: घर से काम
examples: I'm working from home today.
He is working from home this week.
I'll be working from home, but online as usual.
Working from home helps me focus on deep work.

cards.def:
passing responsibility to someone else
हिंदी: काम सौंपना / हैंडओवर
examples: I'll prepare a handover note.
The handover is complete.
The handover went smoothly.
Please add the open tickets to the handover document.

cards.def:
to work together with another person
हिंदी: साथ मिलकर काम करना
examples: Let's pair up on this bug.
Can we pair up after stand-up?
Let's pair up to speed up the review.
New joiners pair up with a mentor for the first week.

cards.def:
two people coding together at one machine
हिंदी: जोड़ी में कोडिंग
examples: Pair programming helped us fix it.
We tried pair programming.
Pair programming is great for onboarding.
We used pair programming to share knowledge across the team.

cards.def:
a quick test to confirm things are basically right
हिंदी: मोटी-मोटी जाँच
examples: Let me do a sanity check first.
Run a sanity check on the build.
Can you give my numbers a quick sanity check?
The sanity check caught a wrong config value.

cards.def:
a basic test that the main functions work
हिंदी: बुनियादी जाँच
examples: The smoke test passed.
We ran a smoke test after deploying.
Run a smoke test before announcing the release.
If the smoke test fails, we roll back.

cards.def:
a test environment resembling production
हिंदी: स्टेजिंग / परीक्षण वातावरण
examples: The fix is live on staging.
Test it on staging first.
Staging is down, so testing is paused.
Please don't use real customer data on staging.

cards.def:
the live environment used by real users
हिंदी: प्रोडक्शन / लाइव वातावरण
examples: The bug appeared in production.
We released to production.
Never test directly in production.
The change has been running in production for a week.

cards.def:
to make software available to users
हिंदी: रिलीज़ करना
examples: The release is scheduled for Friday.
We released version two.
The release notes are ready.
We'll release the update in stages.

cards.def:
a stop on adding new features
हिंदी: फ़ीचर जोड़ना रोकना
examples: The feature freeze begins on Monday.
We're in feature freeze.
After the feature freeze, we only fix bugs.
Can this wait until after the feature freeze?

cards.def:
how much code is checked by tests
हिंदी: टेस्ट कवरेज
examples: Test coverage is at eighty percent.
We need better test coverage.
The new module has good test coverage.
Low test coverage makes refactoring risky.

cards.def:
extra work caused by quick but poor solutions
हिंदी: तकनीकी बकाया / कमज़ोर कोड का बोझ
examples: We should reduce our tech debt.
Tech debt slows us down.
Let's spend one day each sprint on tech debt.
This shortcut will add to our tech debt.

cards.def:
to restructure code without changing behaviour
हिंदी: कोड को सुधारना / दोबारा गढ़ना
examples: I'll refactor the payment module.
We need to refactor this function.
Let's refactor after the release, not before.
The refactor made the code much easier to read.

cards.def:
written explanation of how software works
हिंदी: दस्तावेज़ीकरण
examples: I updated the documentation.
The docs need a refresh.
Please add documentation for the new endpoint.
Good documentation saves new joiners a lot of time.

cards.def:
a meeting to reflect on what went well or not
हिंदी: रेट्रो / पिछली अवधि की समीक्षा बैठक
examples: We'll discuss it in the retro.
The retro is on Friday.
In the retro we agreed to shorten our meetings.
Let's add this to the retro board.

cards.def:
problems and possible threats to progress
हिंदी: रुकावटें और जोखिम
examples: Any blockers or risks to share?
My blockers and risks are listed.
Let's go through blockers and risks first.
I'll flag blockers and risks in the weekly report.

cards.def:
ready and approved
हिंदी: बिल्कुल तैयार
examples: The release is good to go.
The patch is good to go.
Once QA signs off, we're good to go.
Are we good to go for tomorrow's launch?

cards.def:
I agree with the plan
हिंदी: ठीक है / सही लग रहा है
examples: Sounds good, let's do it.
Sounds good to me.
Sounds good — I'll book the room.
"Shall we meet at ten?" "Sounds good."

cards.def:
acceptable to me
हिंदी: मुझे मंज़ूर है
examples: Tomorrow works for me.
That time works for me.
Either option works for me.
Friday works for me if it works for the team.

cards.def:
I will handle this task
हिंदी: मैं इसे ले लेता हूँ
examples: I'll take it, no problem.
I'll take the login bug.
Nobody's on that bug? I'll take it.
If it's small, I'll take it this afternoon.

cards.def:
include me
हिंदी: मुझे भी शामिल समझें
examples: Count me in for the review.
Count me in for pairing.
If you need testers, count me in.
Count me in for the hackathon.

cards.def:
let me handle it
हिंदी: मुझ पर छोड़ दीजिए
examples: Leave it with me, I'll fix it.
Leave it with me, I'll check.
Leave it with me and I'll update you tomorrow.
Don't worry about the invoice; leave it with me.

cards.def:
I'll respond later
हिंदी: मैं आपको बताता हूँ
examples: I'll get back to you by noon.
Let me get back to you on that.
I'll get back to you once I've checked with the team.
Can I get back to you after lunch?

cards.def:
a short query to ask
हिंदी: एक छोटा सवाल
examples: I have a quick question about the API.
Quick question — is the build green?
Quick question: who owns the login service?
Sorry to interrupt — just a quick question.

cards.def:
to be noted officially
हिंदी: रिकॉर्ड के लिए
examples: For the record, I raised this earlier.
For the record, we agreed on Friday.
For the record, the client approved this change.
Just for the record, the tests passed before the deploy.

cards.def:
used to avoid confusion
हिंदी: स्पष्ट कर दूँ
examples: To be clear, I can take two tasks.
To be clear, the deadline is Monday.
To be clear, nothing has been deployed yet.
To be clear, I'm not blaming anyone.

cards.def:
my personal opinion
हिंदी: मेरी छोटी-सी राय
examples: Just my two cents, but let's test first.
Here's my two cents on the design.
If you want my two cents, we should wait.
My two cents: keep the first version simple.

cards.def:
to be logical or understandable
हिंदी: समझ में आना
examples: Does that make sense?
That makes sense to me.
Does the plan make sense to everyone?
It makes sense to test on staging first.
